feeds.title: Women's History Scotland Blog
feeds.description: News, updates, announcements, and historical musings from Women's History Scotland. Founded in 1995, WHS works and promotes study and research in women's and gender history in Scotland and aims to encourage contact between all people interested in women's and gender history in Scotland and provide a forum for discussion on issues relating to them.

feeds.title: Women's History Network Blog
feeds.description: Women's History Network Blog seeks to be a resource for anyone with a passion for women's history. The Women's History Network is a national association and charity for the promotion of women's history and the encouragement of everyone interested in women's history.

feeds.title: Amazing Women In History Blog
feeds.description: Amazing Women In History Blog features stories and accounts of pioneering women unfortunately left out from the annals of history. Browse a wide range of categories depicting fields of arts and science in which women have left their mark.

feeds.title: Evanston Women's History Project Blog
feeds.description: The Evanston Women's History Project Blog accurately summarises and offers commentary on Women's History in Evanston. The Evanston Women's History Project (EWHP) at the Evanston History Center is a collaborative community effort to document and celebrate women and women's organizations part of Evanston's history.

feeds.title: Women's History Association of Ireland
feeds.description: Featured articles, updates, conference reports, and a ton of other resources from WHAI. The Women's History Association of Ireland was formed in 1989 with the aim of promoting research into the history of women in Ireland, bringing together scholars in Irish women's history, recognizing excellence in research, and promoting public engagement.

feeds.title: A Woman to Know
feeds.description: Profiles of once-forgotten women from history, written by Julia Carpenter.

feeds.title: History and Women
feeds.description: History and Women is dedicated to writing biographicals of women in history and also some of the latest and best historical fiction releases. We work closely with authors and publishers to help spread the word about fascinating women and some of the latest releases of women's fiction and women's biographical fiction.

feeds.title: Hidden Herstory
feeds.description: Hidden Herstory is a blog by Chrissy Hamlin about intriguing, infamous & inspiring women from History. She is really passionate about uncovering the hidden her-stories of some lesser-known 'Shero's' and female inspirations in her blog. Chrissy is an English teacher and enthusiastic reader of Women's history books.

feeds.title: The British Newspaper Archive Blog » Women's History
feeds.description: The British Newspaper Archive Blog leans into Women's History exhibiting rare and, enlivening p[photographs and accounts of women from medieval and contemporary history. The British Newspaper Archive is a partnership between the British Library and Findmypast to digitize the British Library's vast collection of newspapers.

feeds.title: Facing Today » Women's History Month
feeds.description: Articles related to celebrating Women's History Month from Facing Today. Facing Today is a Facing History blog. Facing History and Ourselves is a non-profit that combats racism and antisemitism by using history to teach tolerance in classrooms around the globe.

feeds.title: A Mighty Girl Blog » Women's History
feeds.description: A selection of lesser-known narratives depicting how some of the most historic events ever to happen had major contributions from women who were, sadly, lost in the pages. A Mighty Girl is the world's largest collection of books, toys, movies, and music for parents, teachers, and others dedicated to raising smart, confident, and courageous girls.

feeds.title: Smithsonian Magazine » American Women's History Initiative
feeds.description: Learn stories of pioneering Female innovators and their life-changing innovations through in-depth and well-researched articles. Smithsonian magazine places a Smithsonian lens on the world, looking at the topics and subject matters researched, studied and exhibited by the Smithsonian Institution

feeds.title: Women of History
feeds.description: Women of History Blog by Melisende is dedicated to the women who have graced the pages of history, from ancient to modern times. It provides biographies of some of the fascinating women who have graced the pages of history, in addition to articles pertaining to history, and medieval and modern women. Melisende is a bibliophile, avid reader, writer, independent researcher, and history buff.

feeds.title: Australian Women's History Network Blog
feeds.description: VIDA, an initiative of the Australian Women's History Network, is a collaborative blog about the research and practice of feminist history, with a specific focus on gender and women's history. Our goal is to create an open-access blog that makes knowledge of the history of feminism, in Australia and around the world, accessible, approachable, and inspiring.

feeds.title: Association of Black Women Historians Blog
feeds.description: Learn about the legacies and stories of unsung female black figures throughout the history of America. The Association of Black Women Historians is a uniquely focused organizational structure started by three Black women historians with the goals of establishing a network among the members; promoting Black women in the profession; and disseminating information about opportunities in the field.
